change_summary: Treat receipt-bound continuation handles as prior-work context, expose bounded ACL-safe Work Model topology, and report source-aware package freshness without claiming local inspection.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill reports already-visible freshness facts once, treats terminal-receipt handles as prior-work context, and consumes bounded Project topology before the relevant leaf.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-16.3 combines receipt-backed continuation and neutral topology projection with optional host-reported freshness evaluation; it does not move semantic routing into Runtime or claim local inspection.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.52; manifest schema 6 publishes pinned commands for one explicit provider and project/global scope without changing write consent.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI advance to 0.1.0-beta.33. Collaboration status now returns a pinned provider- and scope-specific installer command, a verification command, and one compact non-current Agent notice; conflicts and marketplace copies are not blindly overwritten.

help_center.note: Public guidance covers receipt-backed continuation, bounded structural topology, quiet-current and one-time legacy feedback, with install examples scoped to one explicit host.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart expose loaded release facts, run the first-use freshness check, and treat compact prior-work handles plus bounded topology as actionable context.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history joins receipt-backed continuation and deep-tree topology with source-aware package freshness while preserving separate MCP, CLI, host-loading and semantic owners.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.52 publication and hashes can be verified after release; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover receipt authority, ACL-safe topology, freshness states, provider-scoped update commands, package projection and static host hooks; a fresh external-host semantic rerun remains the live behavior gate.
